title: Hilma af Klint's abstract paintings
summary: In 1906 Swedish artist Hilma af Klint painted her first series of abstract works, part of a large cycle completed by 1915.
why: Among the first major abstract works in Western art.

notes.problem: 'Only shown posthumously' is contradicted: source records a 1928 London exhibition of her abstract works; 'believing the world was not ready' not in source.

unsung.contribution: Painted large abstract works that predate the first purely abstract compositions of Kandinsky, Malevich and Mondrian.
unsung.recognition: She exhibited the abstract works only a handful of times and directed that they remain unseen until twenty years after her death.
